title: celsia lyrata var. sinuata
intro: Celsia lyrata var. sinuata, commonly known as the 'Wavy Celosia', is a flowering plant species in the family Amaranthaceae. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health.
